john.14.p1.b1.text: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.

john.14.p1.b2.text: In My Father’s house are many rooms. … I am going there to prepare a place for you

john.14.p1.b3.text: I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.

john.14.p2.b1.text: You know the way to the place where I am going.”

john.14.p2.b2.text: Lord, … we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?

john.14.p2.b3.text: I am the way and the truth and the life.

john.14.p2.b4.text: No one comes to the Father except through Me.

john.14.p3.b1.text: Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.

john.14.p3.b2.text: Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me?

john.14.p3.b3.text: Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father.

john.14.p3.b4.text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me?

john.14.p4.b1.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing.

john.14.p4.b2.text: He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

john.14.p4.b3.text: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

john.14.p5.b1.text: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

john.14.p5.b2.text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—

john.14.p5.b3.text: The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him.

john.14.p5.b4.text: But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.

john.14.p6.b1.text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

john.14.p6.b2.text: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.

john.14.p6.b3.text: The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.

john.14.p7.b1.text: Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?

john.14.p7.b2.text: If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word.

john.14.p7.b3.text: My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.

john.14.p8.b1.text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things

john.14.p8.b2.text: and will remind you of everything I have told you.

john.14.p8.b3.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives.

john.14.p8.b4.text: Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

john.14.p9.b1.text: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’

john.14.p9.b2.text: If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, …

john.14.p9.b3.text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.

john.14.p10.b1.text: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

john.14.p10.b2.text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father.

john.14.p10.b3.text: Get up! Let us go on from here.
